look: Session board on a dot-grid desk: a provider status card flashing DOWN, a broken single line, a three-tile fallback chain, a request hopping to tile two, and the Gateway end card. Plain. Colors and type from the Zen-Sumi design system: washi paper, sumi ink, rationed vermillion for what is wrong, jade for what is right.

scenes.desc: A provider status card: serving, rate limit ok, then status DOWN.

scenes.desc: One wire from your app to the provider, broken in the middle.
scenes.name: Single line breaks

scenes.desc: Three ordered tiles: first, second, third to try.
scenes.name: Chain of three tiles

scenes.desc: Tile one fails; the request hops to tile two.
scenes.name: Request hops to tile 2

scenes.desc: End card with the Gateway mark: decide the failure before it happens.
